simple.prompt: ___ a brand-new cafeteria on the fourth floor of the headquarters.
simple.explanation: 'A brand-new cafeteria' adalah benda tunggal (singular countable), sehingga keberadaannya dinyatakan dengan 'There is'.
hints: Benda yang ada adalah tunggal ('a cafeteria').

simple.prompt: ___ multiple unresolved discrepancies in the audit log.
simple.explanation: 'Discrepancies' adalah kata benda jamak, sehingga memakai 'There are'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat keberadaan dengan 'There is' dan kata benda tak terhitung (uncountable).
simple.targetSentence: There is fresh water in the dispenser.
simple.explanation: 'Water' adalah uncountable noun, selalu berpasangan dengan bentuk tunggal 'There is'.

simple.prompt: ___ any vegetarian options on today's conference lunch menu?
simple.explanation: Kalimat tanya keberadaan untuk benda jamak ('options') membalik to be ke depan: 'Are there...?'

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat negatif dengan 'There is no'.
simple.targetSentence: There is no doubt about their competence.
simple.explanation: 'Doubt' di sini diperlakukan sebagai kata benda tunggal/abstrak: 'There is no doubt'.

simple.prompt: ___ a projector and several spare cables in the equipment cabinet.
simple.explanation: Aturan kedekatan (rule of proximity): Jika subjek pertama yang disebut setelah to be adalah tunggal ('a projector'), bahasa Inggris baku menggunakan 'There is'.
hints: Perhatikan item pertama yang disebut: 'a projector' (tunggal).
To be menyesuaikan dengan item pertama terdekat.

simple.targetSentence: Is there a parking space available nearby?
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan tunggal: Is there + a parking space + available nearby?
hints: Subjek yang ditanyakan adalah 'a parking space'.

simple.prompt: ___ a quiet reading corner on the second floor of the library.
simple.explanation: Benda yang disebutkan berjumlah tunggal ('a quiet reading corner'), sehingga menggunakan 'There is'.
hints: Perhatikan article 'a' pada 'a quiet reading corner'.

simple.prompt: ___ twelve comfortable chairs around the main conference table.
simple.explanation: Jumlah benda jamak ('twelve comfortable chairs') wajib memakai 'There are'.

simple.prompt: ___ enough fresh water for everyone at the camping site.
simple.explanation: 'Fresh water' adalah kata benda tak terhitung (uncountable noun), sehingga dihitung tunggal dan memakai 'There is'.
hints: Apakah air bisa dihitung satu per satu?

simple.prompt: ___ any direct flights to Makassar after eight tonight?
simple.explanation: Dalam kalimat tanya jamak ('flights'), gunakan 'Are there'.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan resepsionis mengenai fasilitas ruangan.
dialogue: Is there a power outlet near the window desk?
Yes, ___! There is one right beside the lamp.
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan diawali 'Is there', sehingga jawaban singkat yang serasi adalah 'Yes, there is.'

simple.prompt: ___ no parking spaces left near the museum entrance.
simple.explanation: 'Parking spaces' berbentuk jamak, dan 'no' menyatakan negatif tanpa 'not': 'There are no parking spaces'.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan penggunaan 'There is/are' vs 'They are' berikut.
simple.draft: Look at the waiting area; they are five patients waiting for Dr. Sari.
options: Look at the waiting area; there are five patients waiting for Dr. Sari.
Look at the waiting area; there is five patients waiting for Dr. Sari.
Look at the waiting area; they is five patients waiting for Dr. Sari.
simple.explanation: Untuk menyatakan keberadaan sesuatu yang baru diperkenalkan ('ada lima pasien'), gunakan 'there are', bukan 'they are'.
hints: Maknanya 'ada', bukan merujuk kembali pada subjek yang sudah disebut.

simple.prompt: ___ a printer and two scanners in the supply room.
simple.explanation: Sesuai aturan kedekatan (proximity rule) untuk struktur 'There is/are' dengan daftar benda majemuk, verb mengikuti kata benda pertama tepat setelahnya ('a printer' = tunggal -> 'There is').
hints: Periksa item pertama setelah verb: 'a printer' (tunggal).
Struktur 'There is/are' mengikuti benda pertama yang paling dekat.

simple.targetSentence: There isn't any milk left in the office fridge.
simple.explanation: Uncountable noun 'milk' dalam kalimat negatif memakai 'There isn't any'.
hints: Akhiri dengan 'left in the office fridge'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya keberadaan benda tak terhitung.
simple.targetSentence: Is there any sugar in the ceramic jar?
simple.explanation: 'Sugar' tak terhitung, sehingga pertanyaannya memakai 'Is there any'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog di hotel dengan bentuk 'There is/are' yang tepat.
dialogue: Excuse me, ___ a 24-hour gym facility in this building?
Yes, there is. It is located in the basement.
intermediate.explanation: Pertanyaan untuk subjek tunggal 'a gym facility' membalik to be menjadi 'Is there'.

intermediate.prompt: In the future, ___ much more demand for renewable energy specialists.
intermediate.explanation: Bentuk masa depan (future) dari 'there is/are' menggunakan modal 'will' + base form 'be': 'there will be'.
hints: Keterangan waktu masa depan (In the future).

intermediate.prompt: Ten years ago, ___ only a small branch office in this commercial hub.
intermediate.explanation: Keterangan waktu lampau ('Ten years ago') untuk subjek tunggal ('a small branch office') menggunakan 'there was'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat masa lampau jamak 'There were'.
intermediate.targetSentence: There were over fifty participants at the workshop.
intermediate.explanation: Bentuk lampau jamak: 'There were' + plural noun (fifty participants) + place.

intermediate.prompt: Be careful when driving; ___ thick fog over the mountain highway.
intermediate.explanation: Gunakan 'there is' untuk menyatakan eksistensi/keberadaan kabut ('thick fog' = uncountable noun). Jangan tertukar dengan 'it is' yang digunakan untuk cuaca deskriptif ('it is foggy').

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya Present Perfect dengan 'Has there been'.
intermediate.targetSentence: Has there been any progress on the negotiation?
intermediate.explanation: Present perfect: Has + there + been + any progress (uncountable) + on the negotiation?

intermediate.prompt: Pilih jawaban singkat yang tepat untuk pertanyaan jamak.
dialogue: Were there any objections from the community board?
intermediate.explanation: Jawaban singkat negatif untuk pertanyaan 'Were there...?' adalah 'No, there weren't.'
hints: Pertanyaan lampau jamak dijawab dengan 'there weren't'.

intermediate.prompt: Twenty years ago, ___ only two small shops on this entire avenue.
intermediate.explanation: Penanda lampau 'Twenty years ago' + noun jamak 'two small shops' menggunakan 'there were'.

intermediate.prompt: When we checked the warehouse last night, ___ a stray cat near the loading bay.
intermediate.explanation: Keadaan lampau tunggal ('last night' + 'a stray cat') memakai 'there was'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog rencana proyek masa depan.
dialogue: Will our regional branch expand next year?
Yes, ___ at least ten new engineering positions by Q2.
intermediate.explanation: Menyatakan keberadaan di masa depan selalu memakai 'there will be' (berlaku untuk tunggal maupun jamak).

intermediate.prompt: Look at the dark clouds! I think ___ going to be a heavy thunderstorm soon.
intermediate.explanation: Konstruksi eksistensial dengan prediksi 'going to': 'there is going to be' ('there's going to be a heavy thunderstorm').
hints: Mengikuti kata 'going to be' untuk menyatakan 'akan ada'.

intermediate.prompt: ___ been three consecutive delays on that rail line this month.
intermediate.explanation: Present Perfect eksistensial untuk subjek jamak ('three consecutive delays') menggunakan 'There have been'.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan umum menggunakan 'It has' atau 'There have' untuk menyatakan keberadaan.
intermediate.draft: In our neighborhood, it has two public clinics and a community hall.
options: In our neighborhood, there are two public clinics and a community hall.
In our neighborhood, there have two public clinics and a community hall.
In our neighborhood, it is two public clinics and a community hall.
intermediate.explanation: Jangan menerjemahkan kata 'ada' dengan 'it has' atau 'there have'; bahasa Inggris memakai 'there is/there are'.
hints: Bahasa Inggris tidak memakai 'it has' untuk makna 'ada'.

intermediate.prompt: How many participants ___ at yesterday's workshop?
intermediate.explanation: Pertanyaan jumlah masa lampau selalu jamak ('How many participants') dan membalik verb ke depan: 'were there'.

intermediate.prompt: ___ any chance we could reschedule Tuesday's sync to Thursday morning?
Susun kalimat Present Perfect eksistensial negatif.
intermediate.targetSentence: There hasn't been any rain in this region for weeks.
intermediate.explanation: 'Rain' uncountable sehingga Present Perfect negatifnya memakai 'There hasn't been'.
hints: Pasangkan 'any rain' lalu keterangan tempat dan waktu.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat prediksi masa depan tentang keberadaan fasilitas.
intermediate.targetSentence: There will be more bike lanes across downtown next year.
intermediate.explanation: Pola 'There will be + plural noun' menyatakan apa yang akan ada.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kerancuan antara 'There is' (keberadaan eksistensial) dan 'It is' (identifikasi/cuaca).
complex.draft: It is a severe shortage of skilled healthcare personnel in remote provinces.
options: There is a severe shortage of skilled healthcare personnel in remote provinces.
It has a severe shortage of skilled healthcare personnel in remote provinces.
There are a severe shortage of skilled healthcare personnel in remote provinces.
complex.explanation: Untuk menyatakan keberadaan sesuatu hal (existence of a shortage), gunakan konstruksi 'There is', bukan dummy pronoun 'It is'.

complex.prompt: Judging by the empty parking lot, ___ anyone left in the facility.
complex.explanation: Konstruksi modal/evidential: 'There + seems/appears to be'. Untuk bentuk negatif tunggal/unspecified: 'there doesn't seem to be anyone'.

complex.prompt: ___ significant changes in consumer behavior since the digital transformation.
complex.explanation: 'Changes' adalah jamak, dan 'since...' menandakan periode waktu dari masa lalu hingga sekarang (Present Perfect). Bentuk yang tepat adalah 'There have been'.
hints: Ada penanda 'since', gunakan Present Perfect 'There have been'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat formal dengan modal verb kemungkinan 'There must be'.
complex.targetSentence: There must be a logical explanation for this error.
complex.explanation: There + modal (must) + base verb (be) + a logical explanation.
hints: Lanjutkan dengan frasa benda 'a logical explanation'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi subject-verb agreement pada klausa eksistensial formal.
complex.draft: In this contract, there exists several ambiguities regarding warranty coverage.
options: In this contract, there exist several ambiguities regarding warranty coverage.
In this contract, there is existing several ambiguities regarding warranty coverage.
In this contract, there existing several ambiguities regarding warranty coverage.
complex.explanation: Ketika kata kerja eksistensial seperti 'exist', 'remain', atau 'arise' digunakan dengan 'there', kata kerjanya harus bersepakat dengan subjek riil di belakangnya: 'several ambiguities' (jamak) $\rightarrow$ 'there exist' (tanpa akhiran -s).
hints: Kata kerja jamak tidak memakai akhiran -s: 'exist'.

complex.prompt: ___ likely to be considerable opposition to the proposed restructuring.
complex.explanation: Frasa 'There is likely to be...' digunakan untuk memprediksi probabilitas keberadaan suatu hal ('considerable opposition' = uncountable).

dialogue: Is there any possibility of system downtime during the transition?
___ slight chance, but we have backup redundancy ready.
complex.explanation: Menyatakan keberadaan peluang ('a slight chance' = tunggal) menggunakan 'There is a'.

complex.prompt: With automated tools expanding rapidly, ___ bound to be new ethical debates in journalism.
complex.explanation: Subjek sebenarnya adalah frasa jamak 'new ethical debates', sehingga pola modal/semi-modal eksistensial memakai 'there are bound to be'.
hints: Lihat subjek sebenarnya setelah 'to be': 'new ethical debates'.

complex.prompt: Despite strict quality checks, ___ seem to be a few lingering discrepancies in appendix B.
complex.explanation: Pola formal dengan kata kerja pengamatan 'seem/appear' memakai struktur 'there seem(s) to be' menyesuaikan jamak/tunggal noun ('a few lingering discrepancies' -> plural 'seem').
hints: Gunakan konstruksi eksistensial sebelum 'seem to be'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan penggunaan 'there' vs 'it' sebagai subjek semu (dummy subject).
complex.draft: There is essential to back up the production database before running migrations.
options: It is essential to back up the production database before running migrations.
There are essential to back up the production database before running migrations.
It has essential to back up the production database before running migrations.
complex.explanation: Untuk memperkenalkan kata sifat + to-infinitive ('... essential to back up...'), gunakan dummy subject 'It is', BUKAN 'There is'.
hints: Apakah kalimat ini menyatakan keberadaan benda atau penilaian sifat suatu tindakan?

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan analisis bisnis dengan menggabungkan modal dan eksistensial.
dialogue: Could this tariff hike affect shipping rates?
Almost certainly. ___ a sharp rise in freight charges before Q4.
complex.explanation: Pola formal eksistensial kemungkinan dengan noun tunggal ('a sharp rise') adalah: 'There is likely to be...'.
hints: Rumusnya: There is likely to be + singular noun.

complex.prompt: Judging by the empty corridors, ___ must have been an unexpected schedule change.
complex.explanation: Deduksi masa lalu tentang suatu kejadian eksistensial memakai 'there must have been + noun'.

complex.prompt: In strict formal prose, ___ remains little doubt that early intervention reduces costs.
complex.explanation: Konstruksi sastra/akademis dengan 'remain', 'exist', atau 'arise' memakai 'there' eksistensial: 'there remains little doubt'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kesalahan konstruksi partisipial dengan 'There being' dalam kalimat formal berikut.
complex.draft: There was no objection from the board, the resolution passed unanimously.
options: There being no objection from the board, the resolution passed unanimously.
There having no objection from the board, the resolution passed unanimously.
Being no objection from the board there, the resolution passed unanimously.
complex.explanation: Dua klausa independen tidak boleh digabung hanya dengan koma (comma splice); ubah klausa pertama menjadi absolute phrase 'There being no objection...'.
hints: Hindari penggabungan dua kalimat lengkap hanya dengan koma.

complex.prompt: Is there any likelihood of ___ being further delays during customs clearance?
complex.explanation: Setelah preposisi 'of', klausa eksistensial mengambil bentuk gerund: 'of there being + noun'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat formal kemungkinan memakai modal eksistensial 'There might be'.
complex.targetSentence: There might be minor delays caused by coastal fog.
complex.explanation: 'There might be' menyatakan kemungkinan terjadinya suatu kondisi.
hints: Awali dengan 'There might be minor delays'.
Tambahkan frasa partisipial 'caused by coastal fog'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat formal dengan 'There appears to be' untuk satu masalah.
complex.targetSentence: There appears to be a minor discrepancy in section four.
complex.explanation: Subjek tunggal 'a minor discrepancy' membuat verb menjadi tunggal 'appears'.
hints: Lanjutkan dengan 'a minor discrepancy in section four'.
